name: \( P = \eta \rho \dot{V} g h \)
content: Useful power output of a hydroelectric turbine
e: Useful hydroelectric power is P = ηρV̇gh. Larger head h or volume flow V̇ raises the power, and η subtracts losses.

name: \( P = \frac{1}{2} \rho A v^3 \)
content: Wind power incident on a rotor area
e: Wind power on rotor area A is P = ½ρAv³. Power grows with the cube of wind speed v.

name: \( V = A v t \)
content: Volume of air passing through area A in time t
e: The air volume through area A in time t is V = Avt. A wider opening or a faster wind moves more air in the same time.
